mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen to the red cells was most worthwhile: the planned picture and prose show reversible binding to haemoglobin and connect oxygen release to working tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making plasma and adding the remaining cells and platelets felt less informative. The pictures identify the components, but their individual roles receive little explanation.

surprise.text: The developing-cell cutaway shows globin chains being made before maturation into nucleus-free discs. That transition was useful, although globin itself was not explained.

arbitrary.text: No combination felt purposeless: each contributed to the sample. Adding white cells and platelets was less clearly connected to the oxygen-carrying goal because their functions were not explained.

continue.text: I would cautiously continue to see how circulation brings oxygen carriers close to cells. The oxygen-binding explanation was interesting, although several assembly steps felt predictable.
